people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Geshur
people.line: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Hermon_Mount
people.line: Mountain on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Salecah
people.line: City in Bashan, east of the Jordan River

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
translations.bsb: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
translations.kjv: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
translations.asv: and ruled in mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
